The other 5 household types the coordinator pushes have NO enqueue* and get no immediacy — their local writes go through different paths: JournalEntry/JournalChecklistItem/JournalEntryPhoto via Core/Journal/JournalStore.swift + direct appEnv.client.* calls in JournalEntryView.swift; SeedPhoto via its own path; PetDeparture created by PetStateEngine.swift as a system side-effect (and pets are flag-OFF). Fix shape: fire an equivalent 'local household write happened' signal from JournalStore's persist points + the view-level client-call sites (and optionally PetStateEngine) → AppEnvironment.noteHouseholdMutation(), reusing the same debounced coordinator.save(). Flag-gated; must stay flag-OFF byte-identical. Verify: a journal-entry create/edit triggers a debounced immediacy push without a foreground sync (new coordinator test) + full iOS suite green. tier_floor: senior, complexity: M.
design: Reuse the uxc.2 coordinator.save() debounce; only add new fire points on the journal/photo/pet write paths, routed through AppEnvironment.noteHouseholdMutation (already flag+auth gated). Do NOT reach engine.save() directly (bypasses per-record synced-state). Per decisions.md 2026-06-30 (immediacy reuses sync()).

title: R1: reseed-from-local-graph can suppress an unpushed local edit
description: PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by the dirty-tracking change). HouseholdCloudCoordinator's participant seedSyncedStateFromLocalGraph (runs every relaunch, gated only by in-memory 'started') AND migrateIfNeeded's alreadyMigrated path seed per-record synced-state from the FULL current local graph. A genuinely-unpushed local edit (made just before a force-quit, never sent) gets marked synced → pushDirty suppresses it → never syncs (divergence). The old global watermark had the identical defect. Fix shape: gate the reseed behind a durable one-time marker, or seed only from genuinely-fetched mods. Flagged by the Sonnet-5 design phase of the dirty-tracking work. [was umbrella 8ck.8]
close_reason: Fixed: removed the participant full-graph reseed (AC6 covered by the uxc.1 apply-path writer) + gated the owner migrate seed on !alreadyMigrated. +3 tests (2 repros empirically fail pre-fix). Full iOS suite 406 green. iOS fca2cd6 (main, not pushed). ADR + spec written.

title: R1: pushDirty lacks a mid-body epoch re-check (pre-existing; immediacy widens the window)
description: PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by uxc.2). HouseholdCloudCoordinator.runPass checks passEpoch==epoch BETWEEN stages, but pushDirty() itself does not re-check epoch between building its dirtyRecords snapshot and the later engine.save()/sendUntilDrained/commitSyncedState writes. A wipeAndClear (account change) landing mid-pushDirty isn't caught until the next stage boundary, so that pass can still stage + commit synced-state against a coordinator being torn down; a commitSyncedState write can also race the wipe's synced-state-file removal (resurrecting a stale file). uxc.2's per-mutation immediacy multiplies how often sync()/pushDirty run per session, widening the pre-existing window. Fix shape: re-check epoch (or accept a cancellation token) inside pushDirty right before engine.save() staging and again before commitSyncedState; bail if the epoch moved. Verify: a targeted coordinator test that bumps epoch mid-pushDirty asserts no stage/commit occurs + full iOS suite green. tier_floor: senior, complexity: S. Flagged by the uxc.2 concurrency review (2026-06-30).
close_reason: Fixed in 5d722f9: threaded passEpoch into pushDirty + two epoch guards (after fetchInput/before staging, after sendUntilDrained/before commitSyncedState). Post-drain guard closes the only reachable race (sendUntilDrained await is the sole suspension point; fetchInput+staging synchronous on MainActor-isolated coordinator); pre-staging guard belt-and-suspenders. +2 tests (discriminator + stable-epoch over-fire guard); discriminator empirically confirmed FAIL-pre-fix via stash-and-rerun (uxc.3 test-honesty discipline). Full iOS suite 411 tests/48 suites green (was 409+2); flag-OFF byte-identical. Two Arena candidates (pi-nw-glm52/opencode-nw-glm52, neuralwatt/glm-5.2) converged on identical design - reference diffs READ, authored de novo (Arena judge aborted on quota-exhausted gpt-5.5; no winner/nothing applied). ADR: iOS .docs/ai/decisions.md 2026-07-05.
